## transformer-distilbert-v1 vs baseline-linear-v1

Intent macro-F1 delta: **+0.0192** (transformer minus baseline).
Category macro-F1 delta: **+0.0135**.

McNemar on paired predictions: 196 records where exactly one model was right — 68 only the baseline, 128 only the transformer. chi-square = 17.7602, p = 2.5057e-05. Significant at the 0.05 level.

### Per-class, all 77 intents

Transformer better on **50**, baseline better on **16**, tied on **11**.

**The baseline is better on 16 of the 77 intents.** The largest single regression is 0.0481 F1 on `card_acceptance`. Every one of them is listed here rather than summarised, because whether these matter depends on which queue they feed, not on their average:

None of these regressions exceeds 0.05 F1, so on this split the transformer's wins are broad and its losses are shallow. That is the case for promoting it — but it is a different claim from "the transformer is better everywhere", which is not true.
